questions.Description: Measure the dimensions of a ground MS flat or cylindrical bush using a Vernier Caliper and compare the results with a Digital or Dial Vernier Caliper.
Measure the diameter of a wire using a micrometer and compare the result with a digital micrometer.
Measure the thickness of ground MS plates using slip gauges.
Measure the inside diameter of the bore of a cylindrical bush using an inside micrometer and compare the result with a digital micrometer.
Measure the height of gauge blocks or parallel bars using a Vernier height gauge.
Measure the angle of a V-block, taper shank of a drill, or dovetail using a universal bevel protractor.
Measure the angle of a machined surface using a sine bar with slip gauges.
Measure the geometrical dimensions of a V-thread using a thread micrometer.
Measure the geometrical dimensions of a spur gear.
Find out the measurement of a given component and compare it with a standard component using a mechanical comparator and slip gauge.
